execution.transport: Offline reads of saved JSON/TSV/FASTA and frozen file bytes only.

response_capture.transport: Read-only GET of five existing browser-created jobs through their local frontend profiles. No job submission.

comparison.method: Exact deep JSON equality of complete LRECA/SEG native result objects; JSON numeric forms such as 1 and 1.0 represent the same number, while booleans and strings remain distinct.
comparison.case_mapping_note: Module 8 B=LRECA+SEG corresponds to Module 7 C; Module 8 C=SEG-only corresponds to Module 7 B. D/E local outputs also use the Module 7 C combined-method reference.

fuzdrop.data_kind: Explicitly synthetic test-only FuzDrop input; not a scientific prediction or genuine official export.
fuzdrop.label: P

fuzdrop.data_kind: Explicitly synthetic test-only FuzDrop input; not a scientific prediction or genuine official export.
fuzdrop.label: N
fuzdrop.global_value_provenance: The browser run explicitly entered only synthetic pLLPS=0.42 and no TSV. This matches the actual 0.42 fixture; the earlier optional 0.68 prepared fixture was not the E input.

privacy_scan_scope: All decoded keys/string values in five saved job responses and the saved health response; Windows drive/UNC/file URLs, Unix absolute-path tokens, local/private IP endpoints, and any URL outside the explicit official HTTPS hostname allowlist are rejected. Offending values are never exported.

mapper_verification.scope: The production pure mapper is executed in Node over each saved current job and the paired canonical input; no network or scientific model runs.
